rules.description: Applicant receives a qualifying disability benefit
rules.reason_if_failed: You must receive a qualifying disability benefit or meet another eligibility criterion

rules.description: Applicant is registered blind or partially sighted with their local authority
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be registered with your local authority as blind or partially sighted

rules.description: Applicant has medical evidence of epilepsy or severe mental/physical disability
rules.reason_if_failed: You need a certificate from a medical professional confirming your condition

rules.description: Applicant must be resident in the UK
rules.reason_if_failed: This railcard is only available to UK residents

rules.description: Applicant must provide a passport-style photo
rules.reason_if_failed: A digital passport-style photo is required for your railcard

rules.description: Application fee of £20 must be paid
rules.reason_if_failed: The £20 annual fee must be paid to issue the railcard

explanation_template: Disabled Persons Railcard eligibility: {outcome}. You qualify if you receive certain disability benefits, are registered blind/partially sighted, or have medical evidence of qualifying conditions.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has a temporary disability that may not qualify
edge_cases.action: Refer to manual assessment. Railcard is for long-term disabilities lasting at least 12 months.

edge_cases.description: Applicant's disability benefit claim is pending decision
edge_cases.action: Advise to reapply once benefit decision is confirmed. Cannot issue railcard until benefit is awarded.

edge_cases.description: Applicant requires information about companion discount rules
edge_cases.action: Provide guidance: One adult companion travels at 1/3 off when travelling with the railcard holder.

edge_cases.description: Applicant cannot provide immediate evidence but claims eligibility
edge_cases.action: Hand off to customer service for alternative verification methods.
